hypotheses.claim: Existing G9 surface plus canonical typed IR nodes for conditional control, recursive call, Result-like structured failure and pattern match can close the next general-purpose control-flow gap without a FRANK-specific primitive.
hypotheses.support: 50,000 local randomized differential cases, 0 mismatches in a pure bounded subset.
hypotheses.falsifier: Production parser/IR/lowering needs a new primitive to express a required app/FRANK control-flow case.

hypotheses.claim: Function effects should be a transitive fixed-point summary over the call graph and undeclared transitive effects should fail type/effect checking.
hypotheses.support: 20,000 randomized effect-graph mutation cases, 0 false accepts.
hypotheses.falsifier: A sound production effect system achieves equal or better safety/repair cost without transitive function summaries.

hypotheses.claim: Potential-effect summaries must not mint execution authority; runtime EffectPermit/capability validation remains external and fail-closed, including across recursion/re-entry.
hypotheses.support: Effectful wrapper statically valid but runtime call without permit rejected; with matching permit succeeded.
hypotheses.falsifier: Target-host sandbox/FFI proof demonstrates safe authority closure with no distinct runtime authorization identity.

hypotheses.claim: Control/effect meaning belongs in program semantic identity, while runtime permit/attempt identity belongs outside the program semantic hash and inside contract/execution receipts.
hypotheses.support: Candidate canonical hash stable for set-order-equivalent effect declarations and changed for control/effect semantic mutations; Harness independently distinguishes semantic/version/trace identities within shared project ancestry.
hypotheses.falsifier: Production differential replay requires authority-instance identity inside program semantic hash to preserve meaning.
